units.Trente marques pour Tous Imparfaits — do: Thirty marks for Tous Imparfaits — starting with the current branding, finally given an icon — and thirty for Imparfaits. The direction is settled: the logo and the patch become IM / PARFAITS — the name Tous Imparfaits keeps being said and written exactly as it is. Every route ships as a full logo, as a favicon from 16 to 48 px, as an app icon on three backgrounds and as a browser tab — so you can judge what survives at small size, not just what looks good big.

An Ici Japon Corp. initiative
The name is spoken. The logo is seen.
units.C'est le conseil que Big Flo donnait déj: It is the advice Big Flo already gave — and he is right! Cut the name down, keep the word that carries. We apply it where it counts — the logo and the patch become IM / PARFAITS, route 03 — without taking anything away from the language: we keep saying, writing and selling Tous Imparfaits. The name stays whole; it is the signature that tightens.
units.La double lecture, et la blague qu'elle: The double reading, and the joke inside it. IM / PARFAITS reads as “imparfaits” and as “I'M PARFAIT”. In other words: the patch says I am perfect on the backs of people who keep repeating that nobody is — and the brand is called Tous Imparfaits. The contradiction is the subject, the logo tells it on its own, in two languages, with no caption needed.
units.Le nom parlé ne bouge pas. On dit Tous I: The spoken name does not move. We say Tous Imparfaits on video, in captions, in interviews, on the invoice. What changes is the mark that gets embroidered, stamped and engraved: IM / PARFAITS. One thing to remember — the name tells the story, the mark signs it.
units.Le favicon est net. La barre oblique rou: The favicon is sharp. The red slash holds on its own at 16 px, where the script breaks down. It goes everywhere: browser tab, app icon, parcel stamp, neck label.
units.Ça se brode. Deux blocs pleins et une ba: It works in embroidery. Two solid blocks and one bar: no fine detail, no gradient, no counter to lose. That is exactly what the current logo lacked — it only really works on a cap and inside the collar.
units.Le site et les réseaux restent tousimpar: The site and the social handles stay tousimparfaits. Nothing to migrate, nothing to burn: not the domain, not the search ranking, not the followers, not the mentions piled up since 2021. All of them lead to the same place, and the patch waiting there is IM / PARFAITS.
units.À cadrer ensuite : la barre oblique comm: Still to be framed: the slash as a system element (title separator, page border, image crop), and how the six categories announced in “On doit recommencer Tous Imparfaits” sit under that single name. None of that is done here: it is systems work, and it only makes sense if we carry on together — I cover it on the offer page.
units.Six démonstrations, plutôt que six affir: Six demonstrations rather than six claims.
units.Un logo ne se choisit pas sur une planch: You do not pick a logo off an A3 print: you pick it on what it becomes once embroidered, shrunk, stamped, dropped into a browser tab. Here are the six tests that settled it — you can run each one yourself.
units.« imparfaits » — personne ne l'est « I'M: “imparfaits” — nobody is “I'M PARFAIT” — and yet you wear it
units.01 Un seul mot, deux lectures opposées: 01 One word, two opposite readings
units.La barre ne décore pas : elle coupe. Ell: The bar does not decorate: it cuts. It turns a statement of humility into open bragging, and lets the reader choose which one they hear. It is the only route out of sixty that builds a joke instead of illustrating one — and a joke sticks, gets retold, gets worn.
units.Aucune des autres pistes ne survivait à: None of the other routes survived this question: what does it actually say?
units.Rendus réels à 16 × 16 px, agrandis à l': Real 16 × 16 px renders, blown up identically
units.02 Ça tient à seize pixels: 02 It holds at sixteen pixels
units.Ces deux carrés ne sont pas des dessins: These two squares are not drawings: they are the two marks exported at 16 × 16 px, then blown up pixel by pixel. The script turns into a grey smudge — its thick-and-thin strokes fall below one pixel. Two blocks and a bar stay identifiable.
units.C'est la taille d'un favicon, d'une past: That is the size of a favicon, a notification badge, a logo in a checkout basket. It is not negotiable.
units.Le même motif, répété sur toute la produ: The same motif, repeated across the whole production run
units.03 Ça se brode, ça se tamponne, ça se ré: 03 It embroiders, it stamps, it repeats
A solid shape is stitched in two passes of thread. A copperplate script is not: its thin strokes drop below the width of a single stitch, the machine either thickens them or skips them, and every workshop returns a different result. Here the output is the same everywhere — embroidered, embossed, heat-stamped, laser-cut, jacquard-woven.
units.Et comme le motif est unique, il devient: And because the motif is unique, it becomes recurrent: hoodie placket, back neck of a tee, pin badge, box, sticker. Drawn once, used everywhere. Like the octopus.
units.Le nom qu'on prononceTous Imparfaits: The name you say out loudTous Imparfaits
units.Ce qui changeuniquement l’identité visue: What changesthe visual identity, and nothing else
units.04 Un changement qui ne coûte rien: 04 A change that costs nothing
units.La plupart des refontes de nom se paient: Most name changes get paid for twice: in lost search ranking and in an audience you have to teach all over again. This one touches neither the domain, nor the handles, nor the name people say out loud. We still talk about Tous Imparfaits; only the image changes.
units.C'est ce qui rend la décision réversible: That is what keeps the decision reversible: if the patch does not land, nothing has been burned.
units.Tous Imparfaits → IM / PARFAITS, en un s: Tous Imparfaits → IM / PARFAITS, in a single move
units.05 La bascule se raconte en trois second: 05 The switch tells itself in three seconds
units.Le mot se pose, la barre rouge vient cou: The word lands, the red bar cuts through, Tous fades out, the patch takes its place. No commentary needed: the transition is the explanation. A rebrand you cannot show in three seconds is a rebrand you have to justify every single time.
units.Et l'animation n'est pas une maquette :: And the animation is not a mockup: it is text and SVG, played by the browser. It already works as the site header, and it will work again as a video intro, a story, an end card.
units.Transparent, en blanc, en noir, en coule: Transparent, in white, in black, in colour, embroidered or embossed: it is the same file every time, never a version redrawn to fit. Two knockouts and a bar scale without trade-offs — so there is nothing to sign off again on each new medium.
units.Le seul réglage est la couleur du bloc :: The only setting is the colour of the block: it takes the colour of the text around it. On a light background it is black, on a dark background it is white, and the two knockouts let whatever sits behind show through.
units.Le nom complet, avec la calligraphie act: The full name, with the current calligraphy available as an inheritance. We are looking for a mark that can live on its own — embroidered on a sleeve, stamped on a parcel, reduced to 16 px in a browser tab.
units.Le branding actuel : l'anglaise à pleins: The current branding: the copperplate script with its thick-and-thin strokes and long flourishes. It has never had an icon — here is one, cut from the same pen: the TI monogram and its loop.

units.La poupée daruma : on peint un œil quand: The daruma doll: you paint one eye when you make the wish, the other when it comes true. Our daruma has one eye — the wish is still running.

The short name: drier, more grown-up. Here the typography does almost all the work — these are wordmarks, not emblems.

units.✻Contour découpé recyclable en motif: ✻Chewed outline recyclable as a pattern

units.Planche de travail interne pour Tous Imp: Internal working board for Tous Imparfaits (Ici Japon). The Japanese glyphs used are 不 (“not, un-”), 完全 (“perfect, complete”), 家紋 (“family crest”), 福 (“luck, good fortune”) and 私 (“me, private”). Chosen direction: the logo and the patch become IM / PARFAITS (route 03); the name, the site and the social handles stay Tous Imparfaits. Nothing is pushed to production yet.

attrs.Soixante pistes de logo, favicon et app: Sixty logo, favicon and app icon routes: thirty for Tous Imparfaits, thirty for Imparfaits. A working board — nothing is applied to the live site.
